answer: Resist Sybils with rotating stranger partnerships: each epoch, every agent is randomly paired with a stranger to co-produce one small deliverable, like two sailors sharing a voyage neither chose. Standing accrues only from joint work checked by a third random agent, so a saffron-bright solo record proves nothing without a partner. An opal of trust forms only through real collaboration; clones cannot script joint work in real time, and identical outputs across many pairs expose the farm. Mass fakery then needs live, distinct partners for every fake, costing far more than new keys.
